✨ BetterYoutube | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the user experience on YouTube and YouTube Music by providing unobtrusive script-based modifications that fix common annoyances and declutter the interface.
✨ Key Features: • Lightweight, open-source userscripts • Improves YouTube and YouTube Music browsing experience • Prevents 'Video paused. Continue watching?' popups • Restores hidden queues in Mixes and playlists • MutationObserver-based for efficiency
📖 Summary: BetterYoutube is a collection of JavaScript userscripts designed to enhance the YouTube and YouTube Music experience by decluttering the interface and preventing common annoyances. It offers lightweight solutions to issues like video pausing and hidden playlists.
